draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.99, the 130th-best grade among 255 2020 draftees and 20th of 34 at WR. He lasted until pick 161, well after his grade rank (130th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Jakobi Meyers. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 1,318 receiving yards in 2019, 5th of 34 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 7 pro, currently with the New York Jets (practice squad). 61 career games and 13 starts over 6 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 2 AV in 2025 against a career-best 3 in 2021. Versus the typical Year-6 wide receiver who played: 197 receiving yards against a median of 502, below the norm.
